title: Existence support open
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and H a sheaf of sets on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] such that the canonical map H to the terminal sheaf is monic. There is an open W of S such that for every étale U over S, H(U) is a singleton if and only if U → S factors through W → S, and H(U) is empty if no such factorization exists.

proof.text: Monicity into the final sheaf makes section sets subsingletons. Form W as the union of images of all étale objects admitting sections. These images are open because étale maps are open. A section therefore gives factorization through W.

If U factors through W, pull back all the étale objects used in its defining union to U. Their images cover U, giving an étale covering and sections by restriction. Subsingletonness gives compatibility on overlaps, and the sheaf condition glues a unique section. Conversely any section forces factorization; hence absence of factorization forces emptiness. For empty U the empty covering gives the unique section.
